description.value: Now operating as Khao Thai by Legato Cafe, this Thai restaurant and breakfast spot in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood serves an extensive menu of curries, noodles, stir-fries, and appetizers. The business has rebranded from its former identity as a general cafe while retaining the same West 41st Avenue location. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online pickup ordering is offered for those wanting to grab food on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this business 'Legato Cafe,' but the discovered website (khaothaibylegato.com) shows the business now operates under the name 'Khao Thai by Legato Cafe' — a Thai restaurant and breakfast spot at the same address (2248 W 41st Ave, Vancouver, BC V6M1Z8), confirming the address. The website provides a phone number (604-264-1666) absent from OSM, confirms indoor and outdoor seating via OSM tags and a customer review ('I find the food much better when you eat in the restaurant'), shows a menu legend flagging vegetarian items, and offers online pickup ordering; no evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
